scheme_name: Marriage Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

This scheme was officially launched on April 1, 2005. 

It aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged families for the marriage of their daughters. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to alleviate the financial burden associated with marriage ceremonies. 

The scheme specifically targets families that are registered under the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is set at INR 25,000. 

This amount is intended to help cover various expenses related to the marriage. 

The scheme is designed to support families with limited financial resources. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are clearly defined. 

Applicants must be registered members of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

The applicant must have a daughter who is getting married. 

The daughter must be at least 18 years old at the time of marriage. 

There is no specific income limit mentioned for eligibility. 

However, priority is given to families with lower income levels. 

The application process for the Marriage Assistance Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested applicants must obtain the application form from the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board office. 

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

Applicants are required to fill out the form with accurate details. 

Along with the application form, several documents must be submitted. 

These documents include proof of registration with the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board. 

A copy of the marriage invitation card is also required. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of the daughter's age. 

This can be done through a birth certificate or school leaving certificate. 

Once the application is completed and documents are gathered, they must be submitted to the nearest Gujarat Labour Welfare Board office. 

The application can also be submitted online through the official website. 

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The disbursement of funds is typically processed within 30 days of application approval. 

The assistance is provided in the form of a direct bank transfer to the applicant's bank account. 

The scheme is implemented by the Labour and Employment Department of the Government of Gujarat. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is the primary agency responsible for the execution of this scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board office. 

The contact number for the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is 079-232-535-55. 

The official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is www.glwb.gujarat.gov.in. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme has been beneficial for many families across Gujarat. 

It has helped reduce the financial strain associated with weddings. 

The scheme also promotes the social welfare of women by encouraging their marriage. 

As of the latest reports, thousands of families have availed of this scheme since its inception. 

The government has allocated a significant budget for this scheme every financial year. 

In 2022-2023, the budget allocation for the Marriage Assistance Scheme was INR 50 crores. 

This funding ensures that the scheme can continue to provide assistance to eligible families. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Gujarat government. 

The government aims to empower women and support families in need. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme also promotes social awareness. 

It encourages families to celebrate marriages in a dignified manner without excessive expenditure. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many families have expressed gratitude for the timely assistance provided. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme. 

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the scheme meets its objectives. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is an important step towards social equity. 

It addresses the challenges faced by economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme plays a crucial role in promoting gender equality. 

By supporting marriages, it helps to secure the future of young women. 

The assistance provided under this scheme is a significant contribution to women's empowerment. 

The Gujarat government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of its citizens. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a testament to this commitment. 

Overall, the scheme reflects the government's dedication to social welfare. 

It provides essential support to families during a significant life event. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme continues to evolve to meet the needs of the community. 

It is an example of how targeted welfare programs can make a difference. 

The scheme not only provides financial aid but also fosters a sense of community support. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board actively promotes the scheme to ensure maximum outreach. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform eligible families about the scheme. 

This proactive approach has resulted in increased participation in the program. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a vital resource for many families in Gujarat. 

It exemplifies the government's role in facilitating social welfare initiatives. 

The scheme is a crucial part of the state's efforts to uplift marginalized communities. 

The ongoing success of the Marriage Assistance Scheme is indicative of its importance. 

It continues to serve as a lifeline for families facing financial challenges during marriages. 

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board remains dedicated to improving the scheme. 

Future enhancements may include increasing the assistance amount or expanding eligibility criteria. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme is a significant welfare initiative in Gujarat. 

It embodies the principles of social justice and equality. 

The scheme is a valuable resource for families navigating the complexities of marriage. 

The Gujarat government is proud of the positive impact this scheme has had on society. 

The Marriage Assistance Scheme will continue to play a vital role in the lives of many.
